decisions.what: Button grid layout: 4 columns with rows C/⌫/÷/×, 7-9/−, 4-6/+, 1-3/=, 0/.
decisions.why: Spec required a 4×4 grid with 5 rows; 0 spans wider column and . fills remaining slot in row 5

decisions.what: Used data-action='decimal' on the '.' button alongside data-digit attributes on digit buttons
decisions.why: Spec requires data-action for decimal, distinct from data-digit used on numeric buttons

decisions.what: Operator buttons use Unicode minus '−' for display but data-operator='-' for JS parsing
decisions.why: Visual consistency with spec symbols (−, ×, ÷) while keeping machine-readable data attributes
